doc: Convective tendency on a latitude sweep -90..90 in 0.25 degree steps (both poles, the equator, both hemispheres) at the Earth Hadley edge 30. Float64 closed form of gaussians and a smoothstep; the upper clip at 1 engages only at x = 0 (the sum is 1 + 2.3e-11 there), so the tolerance is rtol 1e-12, tight enough to catch a port that drops the clip. A 1-ulp input nudge moves it by under 3e-15 relative.
